blurb: Twisted Limits offers multiple escape rooms with themed interactive scenarios where teams solve puzzles to complete objectives. They also have an axe throwing lounge with 12 lanes and digitally projected games, and a laser tag arena with a 3,000 square foot battleground and advanced equipment. All activities require booking appointments and have age restrictions.
extraNote: Eureka Escape Games: groups larger than 8 book by phone. · Hours are appointment-only; location may not be staffed without reservations · Booking requires first/last name, email, phone number; pay on arrival option available · Guests may bring own food and drink; concessions available on-site for laser tag
